constructed_case: A direct-DAG optimizer sees DiscoveryResultReceipt has no generic downstream runtime consumer and deletes DiscoveryService or its durable result/replay lane as dead-end transit.
required_authority: D12 AUTONOMOUS_FORWARD_SOCIAL_DISCOVERY terminal requirement; D14 autonomous-discovery coverage law; D15 DiscoveryAuthority/DiscoveryService law
observed_result: R02 handoff explicitly retains C11/query -> DiscoveryService -> DiscoveryResultReceipt and freezes Autonomous Discovery. No runtime structural consumer is required because discovery is itself a terminal service/output.
failure_mode: Terminal service mistaken for unused transit because its consumer is authoring/discovery rather than V553-V3 runtime.
required_qualification: Whole-machine minimality must treat a terminal service/output as a lawful final consumer. NO_DOWNSTREAM_RUNTIME_CONSUMER_REQUIRED must never imply retirement of DiscoveryService, DiscoveryAuthority, exact validation, or replay receipts.

constructed_case: A temporally complete single-source structural admission has an exact 1985 effective time; a V554 rule asks only for a bounded affordance at 1985 and needs no comparison or derived interval.
required_authority: V554_AFFORDANCE_RULE_REGISTRY with direct-admission basis authority and exact temporal completeness
observed_result: Direct StructuralEmpiricalAdmission -> V554 preserves the lawful structural use without a no-op V553 object.
failure_mode: Starvation would occur if universal V553 transit were restored or direct V554 were absent.
required_qualification: Retain the typed direct V554 edge only for rule-eligible admissions already complete for the target use.

constructed_case: A direct-V554 affordance is lawful for a local static use, but a later V556 interaction rule attempts to combine its route with a participant from another time/source and thereby claims cross-time persistence or interaction.
required_authority: V553 temporal/comparability authority; V554 basis selection; V556 interaction rule authority
observed_result: R02 states V553 is required when downstream use needs new temporal meaning and permits distinct use classes, but the exact propagation of a later temporal demand back to the selected basis is not frozen.
failure_mode: Object-global bypass classification can become under-bypass when temporal/comparability need first appears at a later reuse.
required_qualification: Basis selection must be governed-use-chain scoped. A later consumer may not infer cross-time meaning from a direct static basis; it must consume an authorized V553-temporalized proposition for that use or fail closed.

constructed_case: Conditioner C selects 37 respondents. Target (Q1,Q2,Q3) has a supported minority configuration 001 with low mass; all unary and pairwise summaries are compatible with multiple different 3-way geometries.
required_authority: D12 exact joint/minority retention law; D13 C11 M01-M18; D15 exact J-way PSEPF law
observed_result: The PSEPF producer is required to preserve the exact requested J-way geometry, including occupied minority cells, and the V3 wrapper pins immutable PSEPF refs instead of copying a modal/scalar summary.
failure_mode: A minimal V3 boundary could silently starve minority/multimodal meaning if runtime reads only a modal cell, marginals, top-k, or scalar score instead of dereferencing the exact field.
required_qualification: V3 intake/metabolism must dereference the full exact requested PSEPF geometry and may not introduce top-k, modal-only, marginal-product, or pairwise substitute semantics. LOW_SUPPORT must remain distinct from ABSENT/IMPOSSIBLE.

constructed_case: One source contains a low-support but observed nonmodal configuration; another source has no such occupied cell. A convenience projection keeps only the modal configuration or converts low support to zero.
required_authority: D12 minority/multimodal law; D15 support/uncertainty and source-indexed field law
observed_result: R02 leaves field geometry producer-owned and requires typed negative/availability state, so the topology can preserve the distinction.
failure_mode: Cost/minimality optimization can suppress supported minority evidence or conflate LOW_SUPPORT, OBSERVED_ZERO, and ZERO_SUPPORT.
required_qualification: Every source component consumed by V3 must preserve exact support semantics: LOW_SUPPORT != OBSERVED_ZERO != ZERO_SUPPORT != TARGET_UNAVAILABLE. No cost-driven truncation may change semantic availability.

constructed_case: For the same actor/query, U1 yields a supported field, U2 yields a conflicting supported field, and U3 is TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE. A thin V3 input is tempted to summarize the set as one available/unavailable state.
required_authority: D12 multi-universe law; D15 source-indexed PSEPF comparison-state and fail-closed comparator/source applicability law
observed_result: PSEPF canonically preserves source components and disagreement/noncomparability, and R02 permits one or more exact source-indexed field refs. The exact V3-side representation of mixed per-source positive/negative states is intentionally not frozen.
failure_mode: Wrapper-level scalar availability or one global negative code can erase source disagreement and component-specific negative authority.
required_qualification: The V3 boundary must preserve or dereference per-source component identities and typed states plus comparison state. A global lifecycle state may exist only in addition to, never instead of, component states. Composition remains NONE_BY_DEFAULT unless separately authorized.

constructed_case: U1 and U2 produce independently admitted, source-indexed structural propositions that disagree. V554/V555 derive separate lawful objects, then a V556 rule attempts to combine the routes as if they were jointly observed in one empirical universe.
required_authority: STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY source-disagreement law; explicit cross-source/sample composition authority where joint empirical meaning is claimed; V556 rule authority
observed_result: D15 requires independent admissions or typed conflict/noncomparability and forbids default averaging. R02 keeps source/universe identity transitively reachable, but the exact V554-V556 source-composition compatibility check is not frozen.
failure_mode: Provenance reachability can be mistaken for permission to compose independent samples into one joint structural relation.
required_qualification: A downstream consumer that creates joint/cross-route semantics across source-derived objects must either possess explicit compatibility/composition authority for that use or return typed NONCOMPARABLE/deny. Reference closure alone grants no composition authority.

constructed_case: U1 and U2 yield textually identical canonical structural propositions under different universe, measure, support, and negative-limit provenance. A duplicate key based only on normalized proposition/use/rule collapses one source.
required_authority: V554 duplicate-equivalence/precedence authority; D12 universe-separation law; admission lineage and authority identity
observed_result: R02 conceptually includes originating admission lineage in the duplicate identity and leaves the exact machine key to V554 close-read, so source-specific admissions need not collapse.
failure_mode: Over-aggressive dedup erases lawful source plurality, disagreement, or distinct negative limits.
required_qualification: The exact equivalence key must be source/universe/estimand/measure/authority-sensitive whenever those distinctions are semantically material. Equality of labels or canonical proposition text is insufficient.

constructed_case: An empirical fact receives ADMISSION_DENIED or NEGATIVE_AUTHORITY_ONLY, or V553 emits TEMPORAL_LIMIT/NONCOMPARABLE. No positive affordance exists. A resolver later interprets missing positive object as ordinary absence/no pressure.
required_authority: D15 StructuralEmpiricalAdmission negative states; V553 temporal-limit authority; V557 publication negative refs; V558 negative-authority locator/resolution policy
observed_result: R02 explicitly says negative/noncomparability state must survive provenance closure and V558 may index negative-authority locators. Physical standalone packaging/resolver behavior remains close-read work.
failure_mode: Typed negative authority collapses into silent absence, allowing fallback or false certainty.
required_qualification: Negative/denial/noncomparability records required for interpretation must remain reachable in the standalone structural bundle and resolver decisions must distinguish DENIED/NONCOMPARABLE/UNKNOWN/VALID_EMPTY from a positive absence claim.

constructed_case: Two generated persons have identical objective comparator facts, identical PSEPF refs, identical ResolvedStructuralContext, and different lawful later encounter/relationship/event histories. An implementation maps field mass directly to belief or response, causing the lives to converge deterministically.
observed_result: Frozen D15 law requires same-field/same-context divergent-life possibility and forbids direct field.mass -> belief/response assignment. R02 preserves the boundary but explicitly does not select the metabolism algorithm; the required metabolism authority is still missing for the corrected target.
failure_mode: Population possibility geometry becomes actor psyche/state or bypasses V3 causal realization.
required_qualification: Fail closed until the V3 metabolism authority specifies lawful proposal/selection influence, history interaction, negative states, randomness/replay, and preserves divergence. The broad edge may remain; terminal developmental behavior is not yet proven.

constructed_case: ActorComparatorReceipt maps generated actor fact `region=R` to one source predicate. V3 consumes the receipt directly as a behavioral prior without querying the target response field.
required_authority: ActorComparabilityService authority; PossibilityFieldService; D12 actor/world noncollapse
observed_result: The receipt contains comparability proof but no target response geometry. R02 makes PossibilityFieldService its direct semantic consumer and only preserves the receipt transitively in V3.
failure_mode: Comparator mapping is promoted into actor propensity despite carrying no target possibility distribution.
required_qualification: Keep ActorComparatorReceipt provenance-only after PSEPF production; no standalone V3 comparator-prior collection.

constructed_case: ReplayReceipt hash/version metadata is fed to a developmental or structural scoring rule because it is always present and easy to index.
required_authority: D13 deterministic replay/provenance law; stage domain authority
observed_result: R02 classifies ReplayReceipt as AUDIT_REPLAY_ONLY and gives it no independent structural or actor semantics.
failure_mode: Provenance metadata becomes causal prior or structural meaning.
required_qualification: Preserve exact replay reachability, but never admit ReplayReceipt as a semantic feature/input unless a future separate authority creates new non-provenance meaning.

target_r02_holding: candidate expression lane; R02 V2/application nonconsumption ruling
constructed_case: V3 exposes an opaque PSEPF/source-disagreement or ResolvedStructuralContext audit ref in an actor-accessible render envelope; V2 dereferences it and changes persona, voice, tone, or belief expression.
required_authority: V3 actor-accessibility/render authority; V2 expression boundary; explicit PSEPF/structural-context nonconsumption law
observed_result: R02 forbids direct PSEPF and ResolvedStructuralContext persona use, but exact audit-ref exposure and V2 negative hardening remain deferred.
failure_mode: An indirect provenance path bypasses a formally absent direct edge and recreates population/structural prior -> expression authority.
required_qualification: Audit/provenance refs crossing the V3 render boundary must be explicitly non-render/non-persona and non-dereferenceable for expression semantics. V2 may express only V3-generated actor-accessible truth.

constructed_case: Every V556 participant can dereference exact universe/query/admission refs, so a consumer assumes those refs authorize pooling or cross-source co-occurrence and creates a composite relation.
required_authority: D12 multi-universe composition law; StructuralEmpiricalAdmission and V556 rule authority
observed_result: R02 H07 proves provenance/replay reachability, not semantic composability. Frozen law independently requires explicit sample/estimand/design/weight/nonduplication authority for pooling/backfill.
failure_mode: Transitive provenance is treated as positive composition authority.
required_qualification: State explicitly that dereferenceability answers `what evidence/authority produced this object`, not `may these objects be composed`. Any cross-universe composition requires separate positive authority or fail-closed noncomparability.

target_r02_holding: R02 principal minimality theorem; R02-H06; R02-H10
constructed_case: A later no-bloat pass removes V557 or V3EmpiricalPossibilityInput because neither creates a new producer-domain ontology and therefore appears to fail a narrowly phrased `first unique semantic transformation` test.
required_authority: R02 retained governance/lifecycle holdings; D15 authority-boundary law
observed_result: R02 itself retains V557 for publication/use governance and the V3 wrapper for lifecycle/use/metabolism applicability, demonstrating that unique owned governance/admission/lifecycle meaning counts even without new domain ontology.
failure_mode: Direct-DAG over-optimization deletes a necessary fail-closed governance boundary while preserving data objects.
required_qualification: Apply the minimality test to unique owned semantic OR governance/admission/lifecycle/negative-authority effect. `No new domain object family` is not by itself a deletion theorem.

constructed_case: Autonomous discovery finds a novel exact 3-way conditioned relationship not individually predeclared. A later structural rule wants to use it. The system either promotes the DiscoveryResultReceipt score directly or cannot route the novel relationship because no legacy packet shape exists.
required_authority: D15 DiscoveryAuthority/EmpiricalQueryEngine; STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY supporting exact joint/branch/source-indexed facts
observed_result: D15 supports exact bounded joint/branch/source-disagreement EmpiricalFact families and requires a separate structural admission. R02 does not require legacy packet transit and forbids score->structure promotion.
failure_mode: Discovery/runtime separation could starve structurally lawful novel results if admission only understood historical fixed packet classes; or leak authority if score is promoted directly.
required_qualification: Retain generic exact EmpiricalFact -> StructuralEmpiricalAdmission capability for authorized novel query families; the discovery receipt remains provenance, never the structural semantic basis.

constructed_case: Raw V553-V556 producer directories are absent. V558 contains runtime locators, but one referenced admission authority snapshot, universe manifest, negative-limit object, or query spec was not physically packaged or content-addressably resolvable.
required_authority: D13 immutable replay/provenance closure; V557 referential-closure proof; V558 standalone repository contract
observed_result: R02 requires standalone V558 to resolve required producer semantics with raw directories absent and declares missing negative/authority/source closure a provenance-starvation failure. Exact packaging is intentionally unresolved.
failure_mode: A formally correct reference DAG terminates in missing bytes/objects at runtime, starving interpretation or replay.
required_qualification: Stage close-read must prove closure over every semantically required positive and negative object/authority, not only producer IDs. Missing or hash-mismatched targets fail closed; no label reconstruction or latest-authority substitution.
